requirement:
Expandable coverage details contain current annotation explanations
and last recorded citation reviews. Test-run provenance and execution
measurements remain in saved artifacts rather than the generated book.
rationale: The two tests marked `{test}` for `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.combined.details` cover each clause of the requirement. **Current annotation explanations** - `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_browses_all_proposals_while_cli_checks_reviews_and_measurements]` renders the book and asserts the explanation text "Invariant fallback, unreachable through the public API." appears along with its source location. - The same test then rewrites the source so the explanation is gone. It asserts the render now shows "No tracked justification is present." This shows the explanations follow the current source. **Last recorded citation reviews** - The same test asserts "Recorded review: Missing" when no review exists. - It loops over recorded `true`, `false` and `FIXME` determinations and asserts "Recorded true", "Recorded false" and "Recorded FIXME" for each. - After the cited annotation changes, it asserts "Recorded true" is still shown and "citations changed" is absent. This shows the last recorded review is kept. **Provenance and measurements stay out of the generated book, and artifacts are preserved** - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_ignores_saved_measurements_and_preserves_artifacts]` records an attempt with a saved test name and line counts. It asserts the rendered chapters are identical to those rendered without any saved run, and that the saved test name never appears in any chapter. - It asserts none of these strings appear: "Line coverage:", "Captured source", "Test runs and provenance", "habeas-coverage-test", "selected test attempts" and "0 unresolved gaps".
